I BELIEVE THAT GOVERNMENT INTERVENTION CAN BE NECESSARY TO CORRECT MARKET FAILURES AND PROTECT PUBLIC INTERESTS.

I SUPPORT OPENING BORDERS TO IMMIGRATION, WITH MANAGED PROCESSES TO ENSURE INTEGRATION AND MUTUAL BENEFIT.
